{{Short description|none}}
{{update|date=September 2025}}
The '''Historical table of the Copa Libertadores''' is a cumulative record of all match results, points and goals of every team that has ever played in the [[Copa Libertadores]] since its inception in 1960, up to 2025 season.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.worldfootball.net/competition/co24/records-all-time-table/|title=Copa Libertadores - All-Time Table (1960-2021)|date=12 May 2021|publisher=WorldFootball|access-date=12 May 2021}}</ref>

The data below does not include the 1948 [[South American Championship of Champions]], as it is not listed by [[CONMEBOL]] either as a Copa Libertadores edition or as an official competition. It must be pointed out, however, that at least in the years 1996 and 1997, [[Conmebol]] entitled equal status to both Copa Libertadores and the 1948 tournament, in that the 1948 champion club (CR Vasco da Gama) was allowed to participate in [[Supercopa Libertadores]], a [[CONMEBOL]] official competition that allowed participation for former Libertadores champions only (for example, not admitting participation for champions of other [[CONMEBOL]] official competitions, such as [[Copa CONMEBOL]]). The 1948 competition is referred to at the Conmebol website as the competition that, 12 years later, would become the Copa Libertadores.<ref>{{Cite web | title=Vasco Da Gama celebrates 116 years {{!}} CONMEBOL | url=http://www.conmebol.com/en/content/vasco-da-gama-celebrates-116-years | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180615191520/http://www.conmebol.com/en/content/vasco-da-gama-celebrates-116-years | archive-date=2018-06-15 | access-date=2026-10-10}}</ref>

== Ranking ==
From 1960 to 2026, 67 editions of the Copa Libertadores de América were held. During this period, the clubs rank in the competition is as follow (updated until [[2025 Copa Libertadores final]]):
